criteria: Publicly redistributable license metadata supplied by the source npm package.
Established quality for production UI, long-form text, display typography, or code.
A balanced mix of Persian-native and Arabic-script families for Persian/Arabic projects.
No duplicate package for the same family; each choice fills a distinct practical role.
curation.note: Typography preferences are subjective. The roles are recommendations, not a claim that one typeface fits every product or editorial context.

selection.notes: All matching font assets from each selected package tarball are included. Package CSS, JavaScript, and unrelated files are intentionally omitted.

families.role: فارسی: متغیر / رابط کاربری و متن
فارسی/عربی: رابط کاربری و پوشش گسترده
